Benign.name: Benign / Normal Network Traffic
Benign.description: Legitimate enterprise communications conforming to standard protocol specifications without anomalous flow deviations, malformed headers, or exfiltration indicators.

DDoS.name: Distributed Denial of Service
DDoS.description: High-volume distributed traffic stream saturating target bandwidth or service resources through coordinated packet flooding (SYN flood, UDP flood, ICMP amplification).

PortScan.name: Port Scanning / Network Reconnaissance
PortScan.description: Systematic probe of transport layer ports to discover active network services, daemon banners, operating system footprints, and accessible attack surfaces.
indicators: Rapid connection attempts to sequential ports
High ratio of SYN without ACK completion
RST flags received from closed ports

BruteForce.name: Credential Brute Force / Dictionary Attack
BruteForce.description: Automated sequential authentication attempts against network management interfaces (SSH, FTP, RDP, Telnet) using dictionary lists or credential stuffing patterns.
indicators: High frequency of failed authentication packets
Repeated SSH key exchange or FTP USER/PASS sequences
Fixed source IP targeting single service daemon

WebAttack.name: Web Application Attack (SQLi / XSS / LFI)
WebAttack.description: Exploitation of web service vulnerabilities through malformed HTTP inputs, SQL injection clauses, Cross-Site Scripting scripts, or local file inclusion path traversals.
indicators: SQL meta-characters (UNION, SELECT, --, OR 1=1) in URI/Body

Infiltration.name: Internal Network Infiltration / Lateral Movement
Infiltration.description: Post-compromise pivot operations across trusted subnets involving privilege escalation, lateral command execution via PsExec/WMI, and token impersonation.

Botnet.name: Botnet Command and Control (C2)
Botnet.description: Beaconing and tasking communication channels established between infected internal hosts and external threat-actor controlled infrastructure via HTTP/DNS tunnels.
indicators: Strict periodic heartbeat beacons with jitter
DNS queries with high Shannon entropy (DGA)

Worms.name: Self-Replicating Network Worm
Worms.description: Autonomous propagation across adjacent vulnerable hosts by exploiting unauthenticated remote code execution flaws without requiring human intervention.
indicators: Identical exploit payloads sent to multiple subnets

Backdoor.name: Persistent Backdoor / Covert Channel
Backdoor.description: Stealthy persistence mechanism granting unauthorized persistent interactive remote access through reverse shells, custom protocol encapsulations, or hooked binaries.

mitre.technique_name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell

indicators: Abnormal parent-child process tree spawning netcat/bash

Ransomware.name: Ransomware Encryption & Staging
Ransomware.description: Massive encryption of local and networked file shares preceded by shadow copy deletion, recovery suppression, and staging for dual-extortion exfiltration.
indicators: Burst in SMB write/rename operations across file shares
High entropy in transferred file blocks
Suspicious payment wallet / tor onion rendezvous traffic
